coordination_holds_append: D-072 moves the project-car bench from its floating predecessor position to the Side A perimeter wall at Y=0.18–0.93 m, below the project-car technical window.

The lift/vehicle test envelope shifts 0.60 m inward to Y=1.05–6.95 m, preserving a nominal 0.12 m graphic separation from the bench and stopping before the Y=7.00 m central axis. This is not manufacturer clearance approval.

Verify real lift posts, arms, doors, vehicle overhang, tool carts, bench drawers, source extraction, power, compressed air, lighting, window drainage, wall backing and emergency working clearances before procurement.
